seo.title: Conditions We Treat | Alpha Sports Medicine
seo.description: From knee and back pain to sports injuries, headaches and running injuries: find the condition, or just tell us what's going on. Four Melbourne clinics.

hero.heading: Conditions We Treat
hero.subheading: You don't need to arrive with a diagnosis, and you don't need to know which practitioner to book. Find the area closest to what you're feeling, or tell us what's going on and we'll work it out with you.

unsure.eyebrow: If you're not sure what's wrong
unsure.heading: Not knowing is completely normal
paragraphs: Pain doesn't always stay where the problem is. A stiff hip can show up as back pain. A tight neck can show up as a headache. Some pain moves around, and some starts without any obvious event at all.
That's why you're not expected to diagnose yourself before you book. Working out what is going on is the first job of your appointment.
Pick the page closest to where it hurts, or tell us what's going on and we'll point you to the right person.

approach.heading: The same careful process, whatever brings you in

steps.title: Understand you first
steps.copy: What your week looks like, what you've already tried and what this is stopping you doing.

steps.title: Look above and below
steps.copy: We assess the painful area and the regions around it that share its workload.

steps.title: Treat and plan together
steps.copy: Hands-on care is paired with something to do between visits, built around your week.

services.heading: You don't have to pick the right practitioner
services.copy: We'll match you with the right person, and our practitioners talk to each other about your care.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral?
faqs.answer: No. You can book directly with any of our practitioners. If you have a GP care plan, WorkCover or TAC claim, mention it when booking so the team can guide you.

faqs.question: What if I don't know what's wrong?
faqs.answer: That's what the first appointment is for. Book with the practitioner you feel suits you best, or call us and describe what's going on. We'll work out a starting point together.

faqs.question: How much does it cost, and can I claim it?
faqs.answer: Our services may be claimable through private health extras cover, depending on your policy, and on-site claiming is available. Check your cover with your fund, or call us for current fees.

faqs.question: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.answer: It depends on what's going on, how long it has been present and what you're working back towards. Your practitioner will talk you through a likely plan after your assessment and review it with you as you go.

faqs.question: Should I rest until my appointment?
faqs.answer: Complete rest isn't usually needed. Keep moving in ways that feel comfortable and ease back on what clearly aggravates it. If you have severe pain, significant swelling after an injury or symptoms that worry you, see your GP or seek urgent care.

closing.heading: Tell us what's going on
closing.copy: Book online, give us a call, or describe the problem and we'll point you to the right person.
